title: Ensure nodev option set on /tmp partition
objective: Remediate CIS checkpoint 1.1.2.1.2: Ensure nodev option set on /tmp partition

playbook_input.description: Parameters the caller provides before execution

parameters.name: fs_option
parameters.description: Filesystem mount option to enforce (e.g., nodev, nosuid, noexec)

steps.name: PRECHECK: Read partition mount state and fstab config
steps.function:
1. Run two read-only checks and register boolean facts:
   a) `findmnt -kn {{ partition }}` — register _partition_is_separate=true if output is non-empty (mounted separately), false if empty.
   b) `grep -E '\s{{ partition }}\s' /etc/fstab | grep -c {{ fs_option }}` — register _option_in_fstab=true if count > 0, false otherwise.
   Use failed_when: false on both. Do NOT modify anything in this step.

parameters.cmd: findmnt -kn {{ partition }}; grep -E '\s{{ partition }}\s' /etc/fstab | grep -c {{ fs_option }}

steps.name: Apply option to partition in /etc/fstab
steps.function:
2. Add {{ fs_option }} to the {{ partition }} mount options in /etc/fstab:
   `sed -i '/\s{{ partition }}\s/ s/\(\s\S\+\)\(\s\S\+\)\(\s\S\+\)\(\s\S\+\)/\1 \2 \3 \4,{{ fs_option }}/' /etc/fstab`
   Guard with `when: _partition_is_separate and not _option_in_fstab`. Use failed_when: false.

steps.name: Remount partition to activate the updated fstab entry
steps.function:
3. Run `mount -o remount {{ partition }}` to activate the {{ fs_option }} option without rebooting.
   Guard with `when: _partition_is_separate and not _option_in_fstab`.
   This MUST run AFTER step-04 (fstab modification), NOT before. Use failed_when: false.

steps.name: VERIFY: Check if option is active on partition
steps.function: 4. Run `findmnt -kn -o OPTIONS {{ partition }}` to read the live mount options of the partition. Register the output as _verify_output. Use failed_when: false. Run only when _partition_is_separate is true.

steps.name: Determine compliance result from verification output
steps.function: Set cis_result based on _verify_output: if the stdout contains '{{ fs_option }}', set cis_result='PASS'; otherwise set cis_result='FAIL'. Run only when _partition_is_separate is true.

steps.name: Finalise compliance status
steps.function:
5. Store the final cis_result using set_fact. Three paths converge here:
   — partition not a separate mount (step-02 on_fail → step-09): cis_result is set to 'SKIP' here before emitting.
   — option already set + verification passed (step-03 on_pass → step-06 → step-07): cis_result already set by step-07.
   — option applied + remounted + verification passed (step-05 → step-06 → step-07): cis_result already set by step-07.
   Ensure cis_result is one of PASS/FAIL/SKIP/ERROR.

steps.name: Generate remediation report
steps.function:
6. Create a task named 'Generate remediation report' using debug msg with EXACTLY this format:
REMEDIATION REPORT — CIS 1.1.2.1.2
Reference: CIS Benchmark checkpoint 1.1.2.1.2
Then for each requirement: REQUIREMENT NN - {{ req_NN }}:
  With fields: Task, Command, Exit code, Data, Status (PASS/FAIL/SKIP/ERROR), Details.
End with OVERALL REMEDIATION: section containing Result: {{ cis_result }}

steps.name: Emit compliance result
steps.function: Output the overall compliance status to the caller.

steps.name: Handle task failure
steps.function: Reached via rescue block on any unexpected task failure.

phases.name: Data Collection
phases.description: Precheck — read partition mount state and fstab config (no modifications).

phases.name: Decision
phases.description: Branch: skip if partition is not a separate mount; skip fstab change if already compliant.

phases.name: Execution
phases.description: Apply fstab modification and remount (only when option is missing).

phases.name: Analysis
phases.description: Finalise compliance status from all execution paths.

phases.name: Reporting
phases.description: Emit the compliance result to the caller.

compliance_constraints: Use failed_when: false on all remediation tasks (except set_fact, debug) so all steps complete and report status

If the remediation targets a specific software/service (e.g., GDM, GNOME, sshd, httpd), FIRST check if it is installed. If NOT installed, SKIP all remediation steps. Do NOT install prerequisite packages.
Use failed_when: false on all remediation tasks (except set_fact, debug, ansible.builtin.fail) so all steps complete and report status
If /tmp is NOT a separate partition (findmnt -kn /tmp returns empty output), set cis_result=SKIP and skip ALL remediation steps. Do NOT install or configure anything.
If the partition is NOT a separate mount (findmnt -kn {{ partition }} returns empty output), set cis_result=SKIP and skip ALL remediation steps. Do NOT install or configure anything.
Use failed_when: false on all remediation tasks (except set_fact, debug, ansible.builtin.fail) so all steps complete and report status.

STEP ORDER IS CRITICAL: (1) modify /etc/fstab with sed, (2) remount the partition with `mount -o remount {{ partition }}`, (3) THEN verify with findmnt. Verification checks LIVE mount options — running it before the remount will always see the old options.
Verification (step-06) uses `findmnt -kn -o OPTIONS {{ partition }}` to check live mount options. Set cis_result=PASS if stdout contains {{ fs_option }}, else FAIL.
reference_procedure:
- IF - a separate partition exists for /tmp.
Edit the /etc/fstab file and add nodev to the fourth field (mounting options) for the /tmp partition.
Example:
<device> /tmp    <fstype>     defaults,rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec,relatime  0 0
Run the following command to remount /tmp with the configured options:
# mount -o remount /tmp
